import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, m, r, c, d;
    static int[] occ = new int[100];
    static Pair[] p = new Pair[100];

    static class Pair {
        int first, second;
        Pair(int first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    static class Edge {
        int to, next, capacity, cost;
        Edge(int to, int next, int capacity, int cost) {
            this.to = to;
            this.next = next;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static class Flow {
        static final int N = 10000;
        static final int M = 20000000;
        static int[] head = new int[N];
        static int edgeCount;
        static int[] dist = new int[N];
        static int[] parent = new int[N];
        static int[] edgeId = new int[N];
        static int source, sink, totalCost;
        static Edge[] edges = new Edge[M];

        static Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        static boolean[] inQueue = new boolean[N];

        static void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int cst) {
            edges[edgeCount] = new Edge(v, head[u], cap, cst);
            head[u] = edgeCount++;
            edges[edgeCount] = new Edge(u, head[v], 0, -cst);
            head[v] = edgeCount++;
        }

        static boolean bellmanFord() {
            Arrays.fill(dist, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            dist[source] = 0;
            q.clear();
            q.add(source);
            Arrays.fill(inQueue, false);
            inQueue[source] = true;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                inQueue[u] = false;
                for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = edges[i].next) {
                    if (edges[i].capacity == 0) continue;
                    if (dist[edges[i].to] > dist[u] + edges[i].cost) {
                        dist[edges[i].to] = dist[u] + edges[i].cost;
                        parent[edges[i].to] = u;
                        edgeId[edges[i].to] = i;
                        if (!inQueue[edges[i].to]) {
                            inQueue[edges[i].to] = true;
                            q.add(edges[i].to);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (dist[sink] == Integer.MAX_VALUE) return false;
            int flow = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            for (int v = sink; v != source; v = parent[v]) {
                flow = Math.min(flow, edges[edgeId[v]].capacity);
            }
            totalCost += dist[sink] * flow;
            for (int v = sink; v != source; v = parent[v]) {
                edges[edgeId[v]].capacity -= flow;
                edges[edgeId[v] ^ 1].capacity += flow;
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        r = sc.nextInt();
        c = sc.nextInt();
        d = sc.nextInt();

        Arrays.fill(Flow.head, -1);
        Flow.edgeCount = 0;

        int source = (r + n + 1) * n + 1;
        int sink = (r + n + 1) * n + 2;
        Flow.source = source;
        Flow.sink = sink;
        Flow.totalCost = 0;

        for (int i = 1; i <= r; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            occ[x]++;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            int first = sc.nextInt();
            int second = sc.nextInt();
            p[i] = new Pair(first, second);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < r + n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= r; k++) {
                    int u1 = i * n + p[j].first;
                    int v1 = (i + 1) * n + p[j].second;
                    Flow.addEdge(u1, v1, 1, (2 * k - 1) * d);

                    int u2 = i * n + p[j].second;
                    int v2 = (i + 1) * n + p[j].first;
                    Flow.addEdge(u2, v2, 1, (2 * k - 1) * d);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= r + n; i++) {
            int u = i * n + 1;
            Flow.addEdge(u, sink, Integer.MAX_VALUE, i * c);
            for (int j = 2; j <= n; j++) {
                int from = (i - 1) * n + j;
                int to = i * n + j;
                Flow.addEdge(from, to, Integer.MAX_VALUE, 0);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            Flow.addEdge(source, i, occ[i], 0);
        }

        while (Flow.bellmanFord());

        System.out.println(Flow.totalCost);
        sc.close();
    }
}
